program:
PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (540e3, 420e3, 700e3),
    "Cf":    (12e-15, 5e-15, 30e-15),
    "I1":    (8e-6, 4e-6, 9.5e-6),
    "Isf":   (5e-6, 3e-6, 7e-6),
    "gmid1": (20, 12, 24),
    "L1":    (0.4, 0.2, 1.0),
    "gmidsf":(20, 12, 24),
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.2),
    "Ipd":   (2e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Rf, Cf, I1, Isf, Ipd = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Ipd"]
    Lb = 1.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)
    vg_dc = m1.vgs
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmidsf"], 0.2, Isf, vds=1.8 - vg_dc, vsb=vg_dc)
    vx = vg_dc + msf.vgs
    mp1 = lut.size("p", 12, p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(1.8 - vx, 0.3))
    mpd = lut.size("p", 12, p["Lp"], Ipd, vds=mp1.vgs)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, iref, vds=0.7)
    mbsf = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, Isf, vds=vg_dc)
    mbp = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, Ipd, vds=1.8 - mpd.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MBSF", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbsf)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    # low-pass filter on the PMOS load gate to suppress amplified bias-chain noise
    n.R("RPB", "pb", "pbf", 2e6)
    n.C("CPB", "pbf", "vdd", 2e-12)
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pbf", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # ---- first-order performance model ----
    a_sf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + mbsf.gds)
    A = m1.gm / (m1.gds + mp1.gds) * a_sf
    zt = Rf * A / (1 + A)
    cx = m1.cdd + mp1.cdd + msf.cgd + msf.cgg * (1 - a_sf) + 2e-15
    gbw = m1.gm * a_sf / (2 * PI * cx)
    cin = cpd + m1.cgg + Cf
    f3 = math.sqrt(gbw / (2 * PI * Rf * cin))
    fsf = msf.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + mbsf.cdd + msf.cgg * 0.2))
    f3 = 0.55 * min(f3, 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rf * Cf) * 1.2, 0.8 * fsf)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    en2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 * (m1.gm + mp1.gm) / m1.gm**2
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    inoise = 1.3 * math.sqrt(4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (w * cin) ** 2)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + Ipd + I1 + Isf)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3, "power": power,
               "in_noise_1m": inoise, "vout_dc": vg_dc,
               "vx_dc": vx, "loop_gain": A}
